resources.string: Stream and search YouTube Music songs. Connect your account from Home for a personalized feed, enjoy sharper artwork, and get started with just three setup screens.
Play a song from Home or Search to build a queue of related songs. The featured card rotates every 15 seconds; the list refreshes when you return after 30 minutes.

string-array.name: orynq_changelog_new
string-array.item: Daily Mix now learns from online listening history and combines familiar songs with related discoveries.
YouTube Music streaming and song search in the native player.
In-app account connection for a personalized Home feed, with encrypted session storage and disconnect controls.
Song radio: playing from Home or Search queues related songs.
Pull down on Home to fetch a fresh YouTube Music feed whenever you want.
A rotating featured card and Search-style song rows on Home.

string-array.name: orynq_changelog_improvements
string-array.item: High-resolution YouTube Music album artwork where available, with safer square-cover selection and video-thumbnail fallback.
More relevant song-only YouTube Music search results.
Featured cards rotate every 15 seconds while Home is visible. After 30 minutes, the song list refreshes when you return.
Three-step onboarding: Welcome, Appearance, and Ready.
A cleaner orynq. header and a simpler About screen.

string-array.name: orynq_changelog_fixes
string-array.item: Create a playlist and add selected songs in one step, with reliable online-song storage and save feedback.
Removed the processing-action notification from ordinary app startup while keeping background playback commands protected.
Search song actions now support radio playback, queue controls, saved playlists, sharing Music links, and live shuffle/repeat controls.
Improved lyrics matching for online songs with missing duration, and plain-lyrics fallback when synced lyrics are unavailable.
Home and Search playback no longer queues unrelated feed or search items.
Related songs stay in the queue when shuffle is turned off.
Improved Google sign-in redirects and loading-state recovery.
